reviews.name: Signal Field
reviews.premise: Electric blue is the ground, white carries the words, and acid lime is reserved for the one post that broke away.

reviews.name: Night Shift
reviews.premise: Dark-first, like a feed at 2 a.m.: deep navy ground, electric blue structure, lime as the only light that breaks away.
logo_ideas: A scatter of blue pixels with one lime pixel far above the cluster
An upward arrow built from a box plot turned on its side
A monogram O whose counter is a pixel grid with one lit square outside

reviews.name: Paper Pixel
reviews.premise: Print-first and editorial: warm paper and ink with ultramarine blocks; lime appears only on blue, like a highlighter on a chart.
logo_ideas: A serif O with a pixel staircase climbing out of its counter
A pixel box plot printed in ultramarine with a highlighter-lime outlier
Stacked open / outlier set in serif, the outlier word lifted one pixel row
